note.phrase.RECOVERY_DAY.1: Today is a recovery day, so we built you an easy workout that moves your body without overloading it.
note.phrase.RECOVERY_DAY.2: Your body needs active recovery today, so the workout is light and pleasant.
note.phrase.RECOVERY_DAY.3: This is a recovery day. Move gently and save your energy for what’s next.
note.phrase.RETURNING.1: {days, plural, one {{days} day has} other {{days} days have}} passed since your last workout, so we’re easing back in with less load.
note.phrase.RETURNING.2: After a break of {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, we’re coming back gently so your body can get used to it again.
note.phrase.RETURNING.3: Back to your routine after {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, at a comfortable pace and without rushing.
note.phrase.DELOAD_WEEK.1: This week we lower the load to give your muscles and tendons time to recover.
note.phrase.DELOAD_WEEK.2: This is a lighter week in the training cycle, with fewer sets and more recovery.
note.phrase.DELOAD_WEEK.3: This is a lighter week. Your body gets stronger while it rests.
note.phrase.PEAK_WEEK.1: This is the peak week of the cycle, so the workout is a bit heavier than usual.
note.phrase.PEAK_WEEK.2: This is a peak week, so we add a little volume and challenge.
note.phrase.BUILD_WEEK.1: This is week {week} of the cycle, and we keep building strength gradually.
note.phrase.BUILD_WEEK.2: We’re in week {week} of the cycle, a stage of steady building.
note.phrase.WEEKLY_GAP.1: This week {domain} has the most left to complete, so the workout fills the gap.
note.phrase.WEEKLY_GAP.2: To balance the week, today has more {domain}.
note.phrase.WEEKLY_GAP.3: {domain} is still {pct}% short of the weekly goal, so today we make it up.
note.phrase.SKILL_FOCUS.1: We added work on {skill}, the skill you chose.
note.phrase.SKILL_FOCUS.2: Part of the workout is dedicated to {skill}, step by step.
note.phrase.SKILL_FOCUS.3: The workout has exercises that move you toward {skill}.
note.phrase.PROGRAM_FOCUS.1: The workout is matched to level {level} in the {program} program.
note.phrase.PROGRAM_FOCUS.2: The exercises were chosen for your level, level {level} in the {program} program.
note.phrase.PROGRAM_FOCUS.3: Everything is built around level {level} in the {program} program.
note.phrase.WEATHER_RAIN.1: It’s rainy today, so we built you a home workout.
note.phrase.WEATHER_RAIN.2: It’s raining outside, so today’s workout is at home.
note.phrase.WEATHER_RAIN.3: It’s rainy today, so we train at home and stay dry.
note.phrase.WEATHER_HEAT.1: It’s very hot today, so the workout is shorter and has more rest.
note.phrase.WEATHER_HEAT.2: In this heat we shorten the workout and give you more time to rest.
note.phrase.WEATHER_HEAT.3: It’s especially hot today, so the workout is shorter and the rests are longer.
note.phrase.WEATHER_COLD.1: It’s cold outside, so we start with a longer warm-up.
note.phrase.WEATHER_COLD.2: On a cold day your body needs more time to warm up, so the warm-up is longer.
note.phrase.WEATHER_COLD.3: It’s cold today, so we spend a few more minutes on the warm-up.
note.phrase.WEATHER_UV.1: The sun is strong today, so the workout is shorter and has more rest.
note.phrase.WEATHER_UV.2: UV is high today, so we shorten the workout and add rest.
note.phrase.WEATHER_UV.3: In strong sun like this, a shorter workout with longer rests is better.
note.phrase.LOCATION_bodyweight.1: We built you a bodyweight-only workout {locIn}, no equipment.
note.phrase.LOCATION_bodyweight.2: You can do all the exercises {locIn}, with no equipment at all.
note.phrase.LOCATION_equipment.1: We built you a workout {locIn} with the equipment that’s there.
note.phrase.LOCATION_equipment.2: The exercises were chosen for what’s available {locIn}.
note.phrase.TIME_morning.1: A morning workout that wakes up your body and gives you energy for the day.
note.phrase.TIME_morning.2: You start the morning with movement, and you’ll feel it all day.
note.phrase.TIME_evening.1: An evening workout at a pace that lets you wind down afterward.
note.phrase.TIME_evening.2: An evening workout that closes the day with good movement.
note.phrase.TIME_night.1: It’s late, so we work at a comfortable pace with no pressure.
note.phrase.TIME_night.2: At this hour we work calmly, without chasing records.
note.phrase.DIFFICULTY_easy.1: This is the easy version, with comfortable exercises and more flow.
note.phrase.DIFFICULTY_easy.2: We chose an easier version so it’s pleasant to stay consistent.
note.phrase.DIFFICULTY_balanced.1: This is a balanced version, with enough challenge and without overdoing it.
note.phrase.DIFFICULTY_balanced.2: The workout is balanced, not too easy and not too hard.
note.phrase.DIFFICULTY_intense.1: This is the intense version, with harder exercises and longer rests.
note.phrase.DIFFICULTY_intense.2: We chose a challenging version that pushes a little beyond the usual.
note.phrase.LEVEL_CEILING.1: In some exercises the level is slightly lower, because it’s the highest we have right now.
note.phrase.LEVEL_CEILING.2: In a few exercises we picked the highest level currently in the library.
note.phrase.MUSCLES_RESTED.1: The muscles you worked recently are resting today, and the work moves to others.
note.phrase.MUSCLES_RESTED.2: We give the muscles you worked recently a rest and strengthen the others.
note.phrase.EXPECT_volume.2: You have {n} in about {dur} min, {sets} of {reps} each.
note.phrase.EXPECT_rest.1: {n}, about {dur} min, with {rest} of rest between sets.
note.phrase.EXPECT_rest.2: You have {n} in about {dur} min, with {rest} of rest between sets.
note.phrase.PROTOCOL_pyramid.1: One of the exercises is built as a pyramid, and each set is a bit more challenging.
note.phrase.PROTOCOL_pyramid.2: The workout has a pyramid exercise that progresses from set to set.
note.phrase.PROTOCOL_antagonist.1: Some exercises come in pairs, so one muscle rests while the other works.
note.phrase.PROTOCOL_antagonist.2: A few exercises are paired, one after the other, which saves time.
note.phrase.PROTOCOL_superset.1: A few exercises come in pairs, back to back with no break between them.
note.phrase.PROTOCOL_superset.2: Some exercises are done back to back, two without stopping.
note.phrase.PROTOCOL_emom.1: Part of the workout is built so that a new set starts at the beginning of every minute.
note.phrase.PROTOCOL_emom.2: In part of the workout every minute opens a new set, and the time left over is your rest.
note.phrase.PROTOCOL_tabata.1: A Tabata round is waiting at the end: {workSec} seconds of work and {restSec} seconds of rest, repeated {rounds, plural, one {once} other {{rounds} times}}.
note.phrase.PROTOCOL_tabata.2: The workout ends with a short Tabata of {rounds} rounds, {workSec} seconds of work and {restSec} seconds of rest.
note.phrase.CALM_evening.1: It’s a good idea to finish with a few calm breaths and slow down for the night.
note.phrase.CALM_evening.2: At the end of the workout, take a deep breath and finish calmly.
note.phrase.CALM_night.1: No need to rush. What matters is finishing with a good feeling.
note.phrase.CALM_night.2: We finish calmly, so it’s easy to fall asleep afterward.
note.phrase.CALM_recovery.1: Nothing to prove here, just move and feel better.
note.phrase.CALM_recovery.2: What matters today is pleasant movement, not effort.
